text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. Unlike simple commands, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind words, including context and tone. One common use is machine translation, such as converting English to Spanish in real time. Another important application is sentiment analysis, where businesses analyze customer reviews to determine if feedback is positive, negative, or neutral. NLP also powers chatbots, which can answer questions or provide support online. While NLP has improved greatly, challenges remain, like understanding sarcasm or idioms. Still, it continues to make human-computer interaction more natural and efficient every day.
